extracted.name: Peanut Butter Strawberry Smoothie
extracted.description: This simple peanut butter strawberry smoothie pairs strawberries and peanut butter with yogurt and milk. The recipe yields one smoothie in 10 minutes.
instruction_lines: Place strawberries, yogurt, milk, peanut butter, and brown sugar together in a blender; blend for 2 minutes then rest for 10 seconds. Blend until smooth, 2 minutes more.
